name: 写真へのアクセス案内を備える画像検索の選択面
prompt: Create compact Japanese Lighthouse photo-access selection panel. Primary original controls fine media/icons/states; native mock secondary Japanese copy/layout. Pure white #FFFFFF surfaces. Header: thin slate X left, exact 'すべての写真' Meiryo Regular14/24 centered with original small DOWN V adjacent to label (not distant generic triangle), right compact green rounded '完了' button white Regular14/24 on restrained135deg #174C36/#1F6444/#2D8F5E gradient. Below access notice WHITE or very light NEUTRAL gray only, no broad mint. Exact Japanese notice '表示されていない写真があります。写真を追加すると、ここから選べます。' Regular12/16 dark, wrap cleanly; at right small white neutral-outlined rounded button '管理' Regular14/24, no bold. Then exact protected LANDSCAPE orchid photograph: flower tops clipped at top, exact stems, white wrapping creases, gray background, lighting/colors/crop unchanged; DO NOT redraw media. Original lower-right pan pill must retain FOUR-DIRECTION white cardinal-arrow cross (four arrowheads on crossing shafts) followed Japanese '移動・サイズ調整' Regular12/16 white. Restore cross omitted by mock. Pan pill stays charcoal/black as original secondary photo-overlay control; Done is primary green. Below exactly two original thumbnails aligned left: first orchid selected with forest-green outline and original white inset, second coral tulip unselected. Preserve both photos EXACT pixels, original crops and sizes, no invention or beautification. White canvas, neutral utility slate#526173, bodyink#1D1D1D. Complete readable Japanese controls, none Bold, compact natural spacing and rounded corners, no phone chrome, extra title, shadows or duplicate content. Protected exact photos and source four-arrow glyph take priority. Static raster candidate, no actual photo permission or selection interaction claim.
reviewNotes: Header X/dropdown/Done, neutral access notice/manage, four-direction pan cross and selected first thumbnail restored. Protected orchid main and both flower thumbnails resynthesized: changed stems/wrapping creases/flower detail/tulip crop. Manage/pan copy heavier than Regular. Exact same media already failed LH01-0069/LH01-0094 bounded original-only edits; reuse valid proof, no unchanged retry. Raster only, no owner or runtime acceptance.
